description: A gaunt, bright green ghoul crouches on its haunches in a graveyard, shown full figure and turned toward the right. It is hairless and skeletal, with long bony limbs, knobby knees drawn up to its chest, and clawed hands; one hand rests on a stone slab at the right. Behind it are dark grey headstones, a broken iron fence and pale clouds in a night sky at the upper left. The ground is speckled black and grey. The creature's green flesh glows against the gloom, and the mood is ghastly and hungry. Frame 1: the ghoul looks right with its mouth shut; held for a moment. Frame 2: its jaw drops open. Frame 3: the head tilts and a red tongue starts to slide out, briefly. Frame 4: the long red tongue lolls fully out of its mouth, held a little longer. Frame 5: the tongue begins to pull back. Frame 6: the mouth is open with the tongue nearly gone, briefly. The loop reads as a slow, hungry lick of the lips.
title: Ghoul crouching among gravestones
